status_definitions.known: O explicitly encodes or discusses the materially same idea but has no direct behavioral measurement of the clean mechanism under the named scope.
status_definitions.evaluated: O has a direct explicit experiment/evidence record on substantially the same mechanism under a named matched scope.
status_definitions.partially_tested: O measured or implemented a related adaptation/submechanism, but not the full clean mechanism or transfer scope.
status_definitions.uncovered: No materially equivalent O mechanism or direct test was found; generic adjacency is insufficient.

assessments.mechanism: Separate shared dynamics learning from task adaptation via an online world model plus MPC/CEM planning.
assessments.clean_scope: ICML 2025 continual-RL; six-task Continual Bench shares state space/dynamics while rewards change and reward functions are provided. OA final AP/Reg 72.93/27.62 versus fine-tuning 24.86/37.74 and Perfect Memory 73.09/30.95.
assessments.uncertainty: Not evidence for arbitrary nonstationary dynamics or open-ended task discovery.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no continual online dynamics learner with reward-conditioned planning; durable replay/context machinery is not model-based continual RL.

assessments.mechanism: Replay quantity can be non-monotonic and harmful; selection/alignment and task geometry matter.
assessments.clean_scope: CoLLAs 2026 theorem in over-parameterized continual linear regression plus neural-SGD examples; strongest formal claim is not a universal neural-network result.
assessments.uncertainty: Neural evidence broadens the warning but does not establish replay is generally harmful.
assessments.o_comparison: O execution replay/journaling is not training-data rehearsal, and no continual-learning replay-count/selection experiment was found.

assessments.mechanism: Curvature/Fisher-aware replay with KL constraints to stabilize interfering directions while preserving plasticity.
assessments.clean_scope: ICML 2025 online continual-learning vision benchmarks. Split-CIFAR100 OCAR final Acc/AAA/worst-val 34.9/48.2/25.0 versus ER 28.2/36.6/12.5; K-FAC/Fisher approximation and vision scope apply.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer to large autoregressive models is unverified.
assessments.o_comparison: No Fisher/K-FAC continual-learning replay or stability-plasticity training mechanism was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Continual LM pre-training with a replay compute sweet spot plus cheap MER/Reptile-style gradient alignment.
assessments.clean_scope: CoLLAs 2026 Spectra/Llama-family 99M-6B, DCLM English→French→German, 100B tokens/language. At 6B retained-loss AVG: sequential 1.47; 25% replay 1.08; 50% 0.97; 25%+Reptile 0.91; 50%+Reptile 0.86. HellaSwag/PiQA/PubMedQA avg is non-monotonic: 69.3 sequential, 75.5 at 25%, 71.0 at 50%, 76.8/77.1 with Reptile.
assessments.uncertainty: Fixed language sequence; 560M downstream table ambiguity is explicitly excluded pending visual verification.
assessments.o_comparison: No O mechanism matches continual LM pre-training with rehearsal fraction plus gradient-alignment updates.

assessments.mechanism: Avoid repeated learning-rate re-warm during continual pre-training using an infinite schedule.
assessments.clean_scope: CoLLAs 2026. CIFAR10 MAE no-replay cosine 58.16 Acc/-17.65 BWT versus infinite 60.03/-12.61; large ViT replay case 48.87/-3.61 versus 50.18/-1.37. 570M LM gains are modest and current German task is essentially tied.
assessments.uncertainty: Evidence is strongest for retention/BWT, not materially improved LM plasticity; optimizer-reset details remain a frontier.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no continual-pretraining LR re-warm/infinite schedule training loop.

assessments.mechanism: Schedule replay in model-time derived from cumulative optimizer-update magnitude rather than wall-clock steps.
assessments.clean_scope: ACL 2026 FOREVER. Qwen3-0.6B OP/BWT improves over fixed baselines across Standard CL/Long Sequence/SuperNI; SuperNI order-7 full 42.5/-2.8 versus fixed-interval 40.1/-5.2, reversed 37.2/-7.8, end-only 40.9/-6.9, step-time 41.3/-3.9.
assessments.uncertainty: External replication, full-parameter/non-LoRA regimes, and optimizer changes remain unresolved.
assessments.o_comparison: O has source/event clocks but no optimizer-magnitude model-time replay mechanism or continual-LM replay study.

assessments.mechanism: External memory relocates stability/plasticity; abstract procedural insights can outperform raw trajectories and retrieval granularity is task-dependent.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026 preprint on ALFWorld/BabyAI. A→B raw trajectory FWT -9.5pp/-7.5pp versus abstract insight +6.5pp/+9.0pp; ALFWorld hard subset raw ΔNL -26.1pp versus insight +3.3pp.
assessments.uncertainty: Only two environment/task pairs; direction and granularity are task-structure dependent.
assessments.o_comparison: O separates durable Episodes/Candidates/fragments from active context and recursively routes optional context, but has not directly compared raw trajectories versus abstract insights or matched retrieval granularities.

assessments.mechanism: History-relative, redundancy-aware online sample selection rather than fixed batch-local top-k.
assessments.clean_scope: ACL 2026 OASIS. At 6.25% retained samples, LLaVA-1.5-7B MICVIT Aavg/Alast fixed-top-FI 62.54/67.16, +ORIS 65.55/72.45, +ORIS+SIREN 67.58/74.51; analogous gains occur on COAST/Adapt. Method uses last-layer gradients despite a contradictory limitation sentence claiming forward-only execution.
assessments.uncertainty: Mainly continual instruction-tuning, multimodal-heavy; FI selection is not established as a universal forgetting optimizer and EMA beta is material.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no online training-sample selector using stream-relative Fisher informativeness, gradient redundancy suppression, or long-run probabilistic quotas.
